notes.claim: Friday, Dec. 4, 4 PM: the Christmas Tree and Windmill Lighting at Drummer Boy Park, with Santa arriving on the Brewster Fire Truck (also the table row "Fri, Dec 4 | Brewster | Christmas Tree and Windmill Lighting")
notes.problem: Supported by the page's 2026 main-events list ("Friday, December 4 at 4 pm"), but the same page's sponsor-events section lists the same lighting as "Leighton Team Keller Williams Realty: December 5, Drummer Boy Park, 4 PM". That section also still carries last year's link ("OceanEdge.com/holiday-happenings-2025"), so it may be leftover text, but the page itself doesn't say which date is right.
notes.note: Kept: the page's '2026 Brewster for the Holidays Main Events' list says Friday, December 4 at 4 pm; the conflicting 'December 5' line sits in a sponsor section that still links to 2025 material (December 5, 2025 was a Friday).

resolved.claim: Lemonadio.com and its partners list The Cape Cod Christmas Market in Mashpee starting Friday, November 27, 2026 (section heading: "from Friday, November 27")
resolved.problem: The verifiable metadata gives a single date ("on Friday, November 27 2026") and doesn't say the market continues after that day. The event link redirects to a dated occurrence (/events/2461427824362331/2461472271024553/), which suggests a multi-date event, but no other 2026 dates are visible.
resolved.resolution: Guide reworded on 2026-11-08 to the single date the page metadata confirms.
